verdict.rationale: Secureframe's own continuous-monitoring feature lets admins set reminders for personnel to finish assigned tasks, including security awareness training completion. This shows first-party tracking of training as an assigned personnel task, but only through a single thin mention. Missing for 10: evidence that training content is built in rather than only tracked, automatic assignment on hire, a documented completion-tracking dashboard or report, training records explicitly used as audit evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, security awareness training is built in — assigned on hire, tracked to completion, and accepted as audit evidence

citations.quote: Set up reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks including policy acceptance and security awareness training completion
